scenario_summary: Customer is locked out of their account, lacks identifying contact information, and is requesting a refund without an order number.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Darnell Robinson and I'm 26. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.

Hello Darnell. I understand you're having trouble accessing your account. For security reasons, I cannot pull up account details by name alone. Do you have your mailing address or the last four digits of the card used for the purchase?
I think the address was 452 Maple Street, Apartment 3B, and the card ends in 4492.

Thanks for that. I see an account matching that address. To proceed with any account changes or refunds, I need to verify your identity. Can you confirm your date of birth and the approximate date of the transaction you are referring to?
My birthday is May 12, 1998. The transaction was probably sometime last week, maybe Tuesday?

Okay, I see the transaction here. Per our standard terms, I cannot process a refund or provide account access without verifying the primary email address on file, as that is our primary security identifier. Since you don't recall it, I'm going to have to escalate this to our account recovery team to ensure we don't violate our privacy policy.
That's really frustrating. Can't you just see it? It's my account.

I apologize for the inconvenience, but I've already checked and I don't have the authorization to bypass the email verification step. I've created a ticket for the specialists to contact you at the phone number associated with the account to verify your identity. You should hear from them within 24 hours.

escalation_reason: Customer failed to provide the primary security identifier (email address) required for account access and refund processing.
